stem.text: In the circuit shown, a potentiometer of total resistance $120\,\Omega$ is connected in parallel with a resistor of resistance $150\,\Omega$ and a resistor of resistance $R$.
The battery has electromotive force (e.m.f.) $12\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance.

stem.alt: Circuit with a 12 V cell, a potentiometer labelled 120 Ω with a slider and voltmeter V, and resistors labelled 150 Ω and R.

stem.text: The voltmeter reads $0\,\text{V}$ when the slider of the potentiometer is $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the way from its lower end, as shown.
